prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: Snabbit puzzle level map composition, full map upward travel, Program the Exit.
Input images: first three references are actual original opening level maps; fourth reference shows original sprites and the chunky stone lever. Use actual game's faceted white-grey stone, turquoise gems, golden stars, orange/green chunky stone toggle levers, navy void, not a new art style.
Primary request: design a beautiful compact original level with a single asymmetric split-comet asteroid, like a broken crown enclosing an airy crooked hollow. It is composed of individual faceted stones on a 16-column staggered hex grid, roughly 44 rows tall. Large visual masses should feel chipped, irregular and weighty; smooth organically flowing negative space gives several distinct little bays. Lower outer open space flows into two unequal programming hollows: a lower left shoulder with one lever and an upper right shoulder with another lever. These are optional early choices, not straight corridors. Both are close enough to see the later puzzle. Above them the split meteor narrows to a tiny left-of-centre neck containing a THIRD lever that cannot be avoided if travelling into the crown. The crown contains two successive short localized stone checks: first a left-of-centre small hidden/ghosted-stone slit immediately above that compulsory lever, then a small solid pale-stone right arch a little higher up. They belong naturally to the broken comet geometry, not horizontal full-width strips. One golden star below the compulsory lever, a second between the later slits, a third above them, and a subtle finish spark in the crooked top opening. Keep all later checks and compulsory lever visible from the early two lever area. The arrangement should feel like looking into a curious small mechanical asteroid sculpture, with a surprising switch-state planning puzzle, no timed obstacle rhythm.
Style/medium: faithful existing 2D game sprites; discrete small asteroid cells, chunky native stone toggle levers with orange handle; deep flat navy backdrop; generous negative space; small cyan gem accents only where useful.
Composition: portrait full map, row zero bottom; different silhouettes and sizes on left and right; a sculpted lower-left shoulder, smaller right spur, broad broken upper crown; one flowing internal hollow, not repeated rooms. Clear visual readability before committing to the central neck. Show all map edges and room above the finish.
Constraints: exactly three levers, exactly three golden stars. Gate blocks must use existing stone or ghosted stone appearance, no colored gate outlines, letters, circuit traces or labels. Do not draw paths or arrows. No HUD, text, grid lines, regular zigzag, gem rails, parallel-walled tracks, repeated modules, rectangular enclosing frame, or full-width barrier bands. No huge painted asteroid shapes: every mass is made of individual original stone sprites. Beautiful authored composition with local narrow checks and breathing room.
